title: Warehouse Pick Delivery Receipt Form
subtitle: Reconcile the promised warehouse pick delivery with actual units, condition, custody, evidence, exceptions, receiving decision, and accountable handoff.
description: An original, fillable warehouse pick delivery receipt form for controlling warehouse pick wave, order, carton, and lot allocation through delivery receipt identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use at Pack station, staging lane, dock, or production point when packing, staging, shipping, or production receiver and the delivering custodian need one receipt that separates physical handoff from inspection, hold, commercial acceptance, and exception resolution.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick delivery receipt identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

fields.label: Wave, pick ticket, and order number
SKU, lot, serial, carton, tote, or license-plate ID

blocks.label: Responsible parties and route points

Pack station, staging lane, dock, or production point

blocks.guidance: Preserve linkage to the pick ticket, warehouse task, item master, and allocation record.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick delivery commitment and receiving readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm what was expected, where it was due, and which controls governed acceptance.

fields.label: Packing, Staging, Shipping, Or Production Receiver

items: FIFO allocation

blocks.guidance: Confirm applicable controls before unloading, opening, moving, or accepting the delivered units.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick delivered-unit reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile each delivered identity and quantity before relying on totals or signatures.

blocks.label: Receipt totals and reconciliation
blocks.guidance: Required, picked, packed, and staged quantity

sections.title: Warehouse Pick condition inspection and receipt evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve observations made before the receiver changes packaging, custody, or physical condition.

blocks.label: Warehouse Pick receipt inspection
items: Wave, order, pick ticket, and destination identify the same work
SKU, description, unit of measure, and requested quantity agree
Source bin and scanned item identity match the released allocation
Lot, serial, expiry, revision, or status meets the selection rule
Picked quantity and pack quantity reconcile without unexplained remainder
Item and packaging show no damage, contamination, or improper exposure
Carton, tote, label, and staging lane identify the correct destination
Substitution or split allocation has explicit authorization
Short pick and replenishment attempts are time-stamped and owned
Unresolved identity, status, count, or condition issue remains on hold

blocks.label: Receipt evidence index
blocks.guidance: Record only necessary proof and preserve privacy or security restrictions.

blocks.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

fields.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

blocks.guidance: Describe facts that cannot be reconstructed from the line table or evidence reference.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Warehouse Pick exception indicators
items: Source bin empty or blocked
SKU or description does not match the released task
Lot, serial, expiry, revision, or inventory status is ineligible
Requested unit of measure differs from available pack
Picked quantity is short, over, or duplicated
Item or packaging is damaged, contaminated, or exposed
Substitution requested without authorization
Carton label or staging destination is incorrect
Replenishment or carrier cutoff cannot be met
System scan and physical identity cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Receipt hold, partial acceptance, refusal, or resolution

sections.title: Warehouse Pick receipt decision and custody transfer
sections.guidance: Separate physical custody from final commercial, quality, safety, or financial acceptance.

blocks.label: Delivery and receiving attestation
blocks.guidance: Attestation confirms the recorded physical event, not waiver of a concealed issue or unresolved review.

sections.title: Warehouse Pick delivery receipt closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this warehouse pick delivery receipt with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by warehouse inventory control lead

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
